_why: Evening sales-only pull so the tapapp cash-off 'Pull sales data now' button sees tonight's takings within minutes of close. Railway cron is UTC: 15:00-23:59 and 00:00-01:59 UTC covers trading and close in both BST and GMT. Re-pulls the last day and upserts, so overlap with the 05:30 nightly job is harmless. Does NOT touch items, labour, bookings or the other nightly steps.
